_README: Hand-entered expected values for verify_stream.py's check-2, eyeballed
frame by frame off data/training/trimmed-video.mp4. The route-sum invariant
(check-1) already covers current+remaining distance for free; this file
exists to cover the fields that invariant CAN'T check: speed, rpm,
power, and the two elevations.
Sampling spans the whole clip (fps=1, 0..58s) instead of the template's
first 5s, because the first few seconds are near-static -- a spread of
timestamps exercises real variation in every field. Only the 6 frames
actually verified by eye are filled in; every other stream frame has no
entry here and is reported SKIP by check-2 (still checked by check-1).
unit_value fields (power/distance/elevation) are written as PLAIN
NUMBERS, not [num, unit] pairs, on purpose: verify_stream only compares
the unit when the EXPECTED value carries one, and these units are
cosmetic constants that OCR reads unreliably (esp. power's 'W', which
psm-8 single-word mode drops -- see CLAUDE.md bug #4). The NUMBER is the
meaningful value; unit PARSING is still covered by test_hud_reader.py's
static-crop tests, where the units read cleanly. riders is left null --
it's the deferred left-panel feature.
Regenerate the matching stream with:
python stream_hud.py --video data/training/trimmed-video.mp4 --start-time 0 \
--end-time 59 --fps 1 --out run.jsonl
python verify_stream.py --stream run.jsonl --total 14.06 \
--expected expected.json
